# System Design In Depth

> An open-source interactive curriculum for system design and distributed systems engineering: 6 engineering tracks, architecture diagrams, interactive simulators, from-scratch algorithmic builds, and authoritative source citations.

## Site

- [Home](https://system-design-in-depth.vedgupta.in/): Curriculum overview and interactive tracks
- [Projects](https://system-design-in-depth.vedgupta.in/projects): Hands-on open-source system design projects
- [Sources](https://github.com/innovatorved/system-design-in-depth/blob/main/SOURCES.md): Primary research bibliography and RFC citations
